title_sq: Ne Allias Shitet Vile 3-Kateshe Totalisht E Investuar Gati Per Banim!!
description_sq: Ne Allias Shitet Vile 3-kateshe Totalisht E Investuar Gati Per Banim. Siperfaqja totale ndertimore e prones eshte 257.7 m2. title_en: In Allias, 3-storey villa for sale, fully invested, ready for habitation!!
description_en: In Allias, a 3-storey villa for sale, fully invested and ready for habitation. The total construction area of ​​the property is 257.7 m2. Each floor has the same building structure and organization with an area of ​​85.9 m2. They are organized by living room, separate kitchen area, 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. The property also has a land area of ​​117.6 m2. The villa is fully invested, with quality construction work and is located in a quite quiet area near the Great Ring Road. The area in which the property is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and peaceful life. It has complete and regular mortgage documentation.
